description: Warn on destructive shell patterns at the point of use. This is advisory context, not the security control: the policy engine in core/zyrompts/policy.py makes the actual allow/deny decision, because prompt text can be argued with and code cannot.

text: This command looks destructive or irreversible. State exactly what it will delete or overwrite, confirm the path is the intended one, and get explicit approval before running it.
If it is a dry run or scoped to a scratch directory, say so and continue.
